title: Shared static SimpleDateFormat (java)
description: A Java class keeps a SimpleDateFormat in a static field. SimpleDateFormat is not thread-safe, so concurrent requests that format or parse through the shared instance can corrupt each other's data. This lexical rule flags the static field; the reviewer moves the formatter to DateTimeFormatter or a per-call formatter.
remediation: Create a formatter per call, or wrap one in a ThreadLocal, or use java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter, which is immutable.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: flags a static SimpleDateFormat field regardless of whether it is ever shared across threads.
